speaker: N
text: Tomorrow, the internet disappears. For seven days.

speaker: N
text: You think you'll be fine. You won't.

speaker: N
text: The lights still work. But your card is useless, your map is blank, and you never learned your mum's number.

speaker: N
text: So you learn a trick. Don't trust the dot. Trust the paper.

speaker: N
text: It works on everything. Cash. Maps. Letters.

speaker: N
text: Until day three, when the shelves start to empty.

speaker: N
text: Every day it gets worse. Day four. Day five. And the rumours move faster than the trucks.

speaker: N
text: But one old man still knows the way home.
